my first time takin a decent drug
Hi I just turned 18 and this is one of my first drugs that I have ever tooken besides the tylonal and that other stuff.
Here is how it went. I went to take some and I went into my bed to watch some TV. Like 15-20 minutes later I feel some tingling feeling on the tips of my fingers. Then I started feeling things differently. Like I was in my bed under my sheets. I usually get warm really fast and take them off but I wasnt feeling warm but I could feel the warmth of the blanket. Same with the air I could feel the coldness of the air but I wasnt cold. The effects lasted pretty long and I was really relaxed. I was able to watch tv for like 2 hours and not move.
